panels.title: Big questions
points: How does your hand move away from a hot pan before you even feel pain?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'And Allah brought you out of your mothers' wombs knowing nothing, and gave you hearing and sight and hearts, that perhaps you would be grateful' (an-Nahl 16:78).

keywords.def: a muscle or gland that responds
gap between neurones crossed by neurotransmitters
plant hormone that causes cell elongation

panels.title: Revision: coordination: nerves, the eye and plant responses
points: Near object: ciliary muscles contract, ligaments slacken, lens fatter
Far object: ciliary muscles relax, ligaments tighten, lens thinner
Bright light: circular iris muscles contract, pupil smaller

panels.title: Explain why a shoot bends towards light from one side. [3 marks]
points: Auxin moves to the shaded side
Auxin causes cells there to elongate more
Shaded side grows faster, so the shoot bends towards light
Answer: Uneven auxin causes uneven elongation
